annotations.title: List integrations assigned to an agent

description:
List integrations assigned to an agent

Returns every integration currently assigned to this voice agent, together with the tools the agent may call through it. The `enabledTools` field decides which of the integration actions the assistant may call: null means the recommended default set for that integration type, an empty array means the assistant may call nothing, and a list of tool names means exactly those tools and no others. Tool names are the `name` values from the integration tool catalogue. A list may only name tools the permissions of the integration allow (`permitted` in the catalogue, see GET /integrations/{id}/permissions); a tool outside them is refused with 422 and error code `tool_not_permitted`, while a malformed list or an unknown tool name stays a 400 `validation_error`. The response is a plain list with no paging, and it includes the health state of each integration so you can see whether a tool would actually work today. Only integrations of the account that owns the agent are listed, which for a reseller key is the customer account: an assignment that points at an integration of another account is left out.

agentId.description: Identifier of the voice agent. Accepted either as the public form `agent_12` or as the bare number `12`; the prefix is stripped before the lookup.
